longDescription:
## What it is

ownCloud is a self-hosted file sync and share platform. PHP + Go, WebDAV-based, federation (ownCloud Global Scale), online editing (Collabora), file versioning, password-protected links, end-to-end encryption, and enterprise features.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a mature, federated self-hosted file sync platform, ownCloud is the answer. The codebase has been around since 2010 and the enterprise features are well-developed.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Dropbox/Drive alternative
- File sync for an enterprise
- Federated file sync (multiple servers)
- Compliance-heavy deployments (with E2E encryption)
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name owncloud -p 80:80 owncloud/server
```

**Manual:** LAMP stack + download from owncloud.com.
pricingDetails: Community: free. Enterprise: from $3,600/year per 100 users.
